Definition: to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be high, be inaccessibly high; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be (too) high (for capture); 1a2) to be high (of prosperity); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be high; 1b2) to be set on high, be (safely) set on high; 1b3) to be exalted (of God); 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to set on high, set (securely) on high; 1c2) to exalt, exalt (in effective hostility); 1d) (Pual) to be set (securely) on high; 1e) (Hiphil) to act exaltedly
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
